description: Establish a green baseline for both halves of the monorepo before touching code: create the work branch off preview, install web dependencies, build the workspace packages, typecheck, and run the worklog slice of the pytest suite. This is the feature that discovers pre-existing failures so later features are not blamed for them.
steps: Confirm the working tree is clean and on branch `preview` (`git -C /projects/sandbox/plane-lab status --short`, `git branch --show-current`). Create and switch to a work branch named `fix/worklog-horas-legiveis-e-responsivo`.
Run `./setup.sh` from the repo root once to generate apps/api/.env from .env.example (required by the API test scripts). It is idempotent; if apps/api/.env already exists, leave it as is.

Run `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types`. The first invocation installs node_modules with pnpm and builds packages/* (slow, expect several minutes). Record whether the typecheck passes on the untouched tree.
Run `ruff check apps/api` and record the result. Do NOT run `ruff format`.

Run `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-api-tests.sh plane/tests/unit/utils/test_service_log_time.py plane/tests/contract/app/test_service_log_app.py plane/tests/contract/app/test_service_log_client_app.py`. The first invocation starts native Postgres on 5433 and Redis on 6380 and builds a Python 3.12 venv under ../.plane-agent-sandbox (slow). Record the pass/fail counts.
Run `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh i18n` and record the result.

Write the baseline results (command, exit status, any pre-existing failures with their names) into the `findings` field of this feature file, then set its status to `completed`. If a command cannot run at all, set status to `blocked` with blocked_reason.retryable and a detail naming the command and the error.
acceptance_criteria: Branch `fix/worklog-horas-legiveis-e-responsivo` exists and is checked out, created from `preview`.
node_modules and packages/*/dist exist, and the output of `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types` is recorded in findings.
The three named pytest files have been executed and their pass/fail counts are recorded in findings.
findings names every pre-existing failure (or states explicitly that there were none) so later features can be judged against it.
findings:
BASELINE on the untouched tree (branch fix/worklog-horas-legiveis-e-responsivo created from preview @ fd81e0a07; the only working-tree change was this task-state directory).

1. `./setup.sh` -> exit 0. Generated .env, apps/web/.env, apps/api/.env (+ SECRET_KEY), apps/space/.env, apps/admin/.env, apps/live/.env. All are gitignored, so `git status` stays clean. It prints `corepack: command not found` / `pnpm: command not found` at the end and reports 'Some issues occurred during setup' -- EXPECTED and harmless in this sandbox, node is not on PATH for a bare shell; tools/agent-sandbox/* put it on PATH themselves.

2. `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types` -> exit 0, CLEAN. First run did `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (~19s after download) and `turbo run build --filter=./packages/*` (12/12 successful, ~22s), then react-router typegen + tsc --noEmit for web with no errors. node_modules and packages/*/dist now exist. Benign noise in the output that is NOT a failure: the vite-tsconfig-paths deprecation hint and MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning for packages/tailwind-config/postcss.config.js.

3. `ruff check apps/api` -> exit 1, 18 PRE-EXISTING errors (15 auto-fixable). ruff is NOT on PATH and is not installed by run-api-tests.sh (it is in requirements/local.txt, the venv only gets base.txt+test.txt); installed it with `/projects/sandbox/.plane-agent-sandbox/venv-api/bin/pip install ruff==0.9.7` and invoked it as `/projects/sandbox/.plane-agent-sandbox/venv-api/bin/ruff check apps/api`. The 18 pre-existing errors, by file:line:rule -- app/serializers/service_issue_allowance.py:13 F401 format_hours unused; app/views/issue/base.py:510 F841 project; app/views/issue/sub_issue.py:10 F401 Func, F401 Q; app/views/project/invite.py:31 F401 User; app/views/service_log/base.py:62 F401 format_hours unused; db/management/commands/seed_service_demo.py:728 E501; tests/contract/app/test_service_log_client_app.py:173 E501; tests/unit/commands/test_seed_service_demo.py:200 and :201 F541; tests/unit/utils/test_service_billing_origins.py:42 F401 INTERNAL_WORK_FAILURES, :43 F401 PRICING_PENDENCY_FAILURES; tests/unit/utils/test_service_reports.py:30 F401 ServiceLog; utils/service_allowance.py:482 F401 reverse_debit; utils/service_reports.py:56 F401 F, F401 Q, :65 F401 ServiceLog, :72 F401 ServiceLogFilterSet. NOTE for later features: the two `F401 format_hours imported but unused` hits (service_issue_allowance.py:13 and service_log/base.py:62) are leftovers of the partial humanization work; if a later feature stops using format_hours in a file it should remove the import, and if it starts using it the warning disappears on its own. Do not mass-fix the other 16 -- out of scope, unrelated churn. `ruff format` was NOT run.

4. `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-api-tests.sh plane/tests/unit/utils/test_service_log_time.py plane/tests/contract/app/test_service_log_app.py plane/tests/contract/app/test_service_log_client_app.py` -> pytest exit 1: **1 failed, 690 passed, 78 warnings in 31.53s**. First run started native Postgres on 5433 / Redis on 6380 and built the Python 3.12 venv at /projects/sandbox/.plane-agent-sandbox/venv-api. RECREATE_DB was not needed. The single PRE-EXISTING FAILURE is:
   - plane/tests/contract/app/test_service_log_app.py::TestListingAndTotals::test_totals_carry_a_pt_br_rendering (line 735): `assert response.data['logged_hours_display'] == '1,25h'` fails with actual `'1h 15min'`. This is a STALE TEST EXPECTATION, not a product bug: the /totals endpoint was already switched to format_hours_human by the earlier humanization commits (d5bd45b9f..fd81e0a07) but this assertion was not updated. FEAT-002 must update this test to expect the humanized string (and keep asserting the R11 dual reading, i.e. that the client-facing equivalent quantity is still a separate value), NOT revert the endpoint.
   Benign warning present in every run: `UserWarning: No directory at: apps/api/plane/static-assets/collected-static/`.

5. `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh i18n` -> exit 0. All 19 locales at 4,370 keys, 100% parity with English, 'No issues found'.

6. Extra baseline check (not in the steps, done because the husky pre-commit hook fails on ANY oxlint warning in a staged file): `./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh lint apps/web/core/components/service-logs` -> exit 0, 'Found 0 warnings and 0 errors' on 13 files. So the service-logs directory starts warning-free and any oxlint warning seen later is ours. The script prints a batch of `npm warn Unknown project config ...` lines first; ignore them.

SANDBOX GOTCHAS worth carrying into FEAT-002/003:
- /tmp does NOT persist between execute_bash invocations, and backgrounded processes are killed when the spawning shell returns (even with setsid+nohup+disown). Run the slow scripts in the FOREGROUND with a large timeout and, if you want a log file, put it under /projects/sandbox/, not /tmp.
- Docker/podman was not attempted; the native scripts covered everything.
- Only the .agents task-state files are tracked changes so far; no source file was modified by this feature.
